name: Extract Candidate Data from Any Resume and Save to Google Sheets Automatically

nodes.name: 1. Receive Resume Email
nodes.notes: Checks the Resumes label every minute for emails with resume files or ZIPs and downloads the attachments. Passes the email to 3. Check Resume Files & Unzip (and to 2. Read Sheet Column Headers).

filters.q: has:attachment {filename:pdf filename:docx filename:doc filename:rtf filename:zip filename:txt filename:html filename:htm filename:odt filename:docm filename:dotm filename:dot filename:dotx filename:png filename:jpeg filename:jpg filename:mht filename:mhtml}

nodes.name: 2. Read Sheet Column Headers
nodes.notes: Reads row 1 (the column names) of the Candidate tab ONCE per run, so Google is not called once per resume. It sits above the main line, so it runs first. 5. Map Fields to Sheet Row fills exactly these columns: add a header to the sheet any time and the next run uses it. The header "Date Received" must exist (the read looks for it).

nodes.name: 3. Check Resume Files & Unzip
nodes.notes: Opens every attachment and ZIP, checks each file (not empty, smaller than 5 MiB, a real resume type read from the file content) and READS ITS TEXT, so no other node is needed for PDF, Word, RTF, ODT, HTML, MHT or TXT. One item per resume with its text. Problem files are marked and logged with their reason, never parsed. Pictures (PNG, JPEG, JPG) are read with RChilli OCR here (set your userkey and subuserid in the PICTURE OCR settings at the top of the code).

nodes.name: 4. Send 5 Resumes at a Time
nodes.notes: Batch processing: sends the resumes to RChilli 5 at a time. The next batch starts when the previous 5 are mapped (5. Parse > 6. Map loops back here). When all batches are done, everything moves on to 7. Candidate Data Extracted?.

nodes.name: 5. Resume Data Extraction (RChilli MCP)
nodes.notes: RChilli MCP (extract_resume_data): sends the resume TEXT (never shortened, RChilli applies its own 60,000 character limit) and the file name, and gets the structured resume back, one resume at a time inside each batch of 5. Problem files send empty text and are logged by node 6 with their own reason. Errors are caught per resume and logged with the RChilli code.

nodes.name: 6. Map Candidate Data to Sheet Columns
nodes.notes: Builds one sheet row, no AI. Fills ONLY the columns in row 1: standard columns first, then any header you add is matched to the stored RChilli field list (211 fields), then to a "Label: value" line in the resume text. Nothing found = empty cell. A rejected file becomes an exception row. Goes back to node 4 for the next batch.

nodes.name: 7. Candidate Data Extracted?
nodes.notes: A good row goes up to 7a. Save to Candidate Data, a rejected file goes down to 7b. Log Rejected Resume.

nodes.name: 8a. Save Candidate Record to Google Sheets
nodes.notes: Adds the good resumes as new rows. The columns come from row 1 of the sheet itself (no stored column list), so a header you add is written automatically. The extra "_mapping_info" value is ignored here; it only shows in the execution view how each column was filled.

nodes.name: 8b. Log Failed Resume to Exception Log
nodes.notes: Appends the rejected file to the Exception Logs tab (LLM Testing Logs) with sender, subject, file name and the plain-English Reason.

parameters.content:
## 📋 What this workflow does
You email resumes to Gmail. This workflow reads them with the **RChilli MCP** and fills a Google Sheet for you. No AI.

1️⃣ **Get** the files from the email, unzip ZIPs, check every file and **read its text** (PDF, Word, RTF, ODT, TXT, HTML, MHT)
2️⃣ **Send 5 resumes at a time** to RChilli (it takes resume text)
3️⃣ **Map** the result to the columns in row 1 of your sheet. Add a header any time and it is filled when RChilli found that information
4️⃣ **Save** ✅ good resumes → **Candidate** tab · ⚠️ problem files → **Exception Logs** tab, with the reason

👉 First time? Follow the **SETUP** note on the right.

## 📬 Step 1: Get, check and read the resume files

**1. Receive Resume Email** – checks the **Resumes** label every minute.

**2. Read Sheet Column Headers** – reads the column names in row 1 of your Candidate tab (once per run).

**3. Check Resume Files & Unzip** – opens ZIPs, checks every file (not empty, **under 5 MiB**, a real resume type) and reads its text. A problem file is logged with its reason and never parsed.

## 🤖 Step 2: Resume Data Extraction with RChilli MCP, 5 at a time

**4. Send 5 Resumes at a Time** – batch processing: 5 resumes go to RChilli, the next 5 start when those are mapped.

**5. Resume Data Extraction (RChilli MCP)** – the RChilli MCP reads the resume text and returns the structured resume. Error codes are caught per resume.

## 🧩 Step 3: Map candidate data to your columns

**6. Map Candidate Data to Sheet Columns** – fills ONLY the columns in row 1. A header you add later is matched to the RChilli field list stored here (211 fields), then to a "Label: value" line in the resume. Nothing found = empty.

## 📊 Step 4: Save the candidate record (after all batches)

**7. Candidate Data Extracted?** – good resume goes up, problem file goes down.
**8a. Save Candidate Record to Google Sheets** – adds the good resumes as new rows.
**8b. Log Failed Resume to Exception Log** – writes the problem file and its reason to the Exception Logs tab.

## 🛠️ SETUP (do this once, about 5 minutes)

**A. Your Google Sheet** (one file, two tabs)
1. **Candidate Data** tab: row 1 = your column names. Required: **Date Received**. Suggested: Date Received, Full Name, Email, Phone, Location, Current Role, Employer, Years Of Experience, Skills, Institute Name, Qualification, Profile Link, Source, Resume Link, Status, Sender Email, Subject, File Name, Reason, Date Of Birth, Nationality.
2. **Exception Logs** tab: row 1 must be **Date Received, Sender Email, Subject, File Name, Reason**.
✅ **To add a new column later, just add a header in row 1.** It is filled by itself when RChilli found that information (about 210 RChilli fields are known, e.g. Gender, Passport Number, Total Experience In Months, Executive Summary, Languages Known, Category).

**B. Gmail label** – create a label **Resumes** and move resume emails there.

**C. Credentials** – 1. Receive Resume Email → your Gmail · 2. Read Sheet Column Headers, 8a, 8b → your Google account · **5. Resume Data Extraction (RChilli MCP) → your RChilli MCP credential** (RChilli MCP Authentication).

**D. Publish** – send 3 test files first (a PDF, a Word file and a ZIP), then turn the workflow on. Run one execution at a time.
